ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as date) union all select sr_store_sk as store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk as date_sk, cast(0 as cr_return_amount as return_amt, cr_net_loss as net_loss from catalog_returns join date_dim on cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast('2000-08-19' as date) and cast('2000-09-02' as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss from ( select ws_web_site_sk as wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk as date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price as sales_price, ws_net_profit as profit, cast(0 as decimal(7,2)) net_loss from web_returns left join web_sales on ( wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk and wr_order_number = ws_order_number) join date_dim on wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_date between cast('2000-08-19' sum(profit) as profit from (select 'store channel' as channel, 'store' || s_store_id as id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit from ssr union all select 'catalog channel' as channel, 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id as id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit from csr union all select 'web channel' as channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id as id, sales, returns, (profit - profit_loss) as profit from wsr) x group by rollup (channel, id) order by channel, id limit 100
